svg.aria-label: Isometric cutaway of an Archegon enhanced geothermal site: a drilling rig and two well pairs turning horizontal in hot granite with a stimulated fracture zone between them; hot brine piped to an ORC binary plant with an air-cooled condenser; reinjection and a make-up water bore; generator, transformer, switchgear, battery and gas backup; four 1.25 MW data-centre modules; and a fibre link towards Moomba. Illustrative, not to scale.
